The genes you were born with? Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoIt’s a difficult question to contemplate (and one some people struggle their whole lives trying to answer). The answer is more fascinating, but still fraught: The two interact in interesting ways to produce your unique personality. That doesn’t mean, though, you don’t start with a blueprint that can nudge you in certain directions.
